TABULA TEMPORARIA — ANNO DOMINI 2027
============================================================
  Golden Number                XIV
  Dominical Letter             C
  Sundays after Epiphany       7
  Sundays after Pentecost      22

  MOVEABLE FEASTS
    Septuagesima Sunday      February 28
    Ash Wednesday            March 17
    Easter (Pascha) Day      May 2
    Ascension Day            June 10
    Pentecost                June 20
    Corpus Christi           July 1
    Advent Sunday            November 28

  EMBER DAYS
    Spring (Lent)            March 24, 26, 27
    Summer (Whitsun)         June 23, 25, 26
    Autumn (Holy Cross)      September 15, 17, 18
    Winter (Advent)          December 15, 17, 18
